title_zh: 请求临床人员解答诊疗前用药问题

scenario.label_zh: 请求临床人员回电解答诊疗前用药疑问
scenario.goal_zh: 说明计划接受诊疗及用药疑问，请接待员安排临床人员当日回电

context_zh: 虚构诊所咨询语言练习，仅请求转交疑问，不给出用药或诊疗建议。
author: author-phase09-c

sentences.speaker: Nadia
sentences.text: I'm due to undergo a procedure on Friday, and I have a question about a vitamin supplement I take.

sentences.speaker: Receptionist
sentences.text: I can ask a clinician to call you. Do you need an assessment for a new problem today?

sentences.speaker: Nadia
sentences.text: No. I don't have acute pain or a new symptom. I just don't understand the preparation letter.

sentences.speaker: Receptionist
sentences.text: What part would you like the clinician to explain?

sentences.speaker: Nadia
sentences.text: It says a nurse will administer the medicine here. I'm unsure what I'm supposed to bring from home.

sentences.speaker: Receptionist
sentences.text: I'll put that question in the message. It's vital that the clinical team, rather than reception, answers the medication question.

sentences.speaker: Nadia
sentences.text: Could they call today? I'll be available after two.

sentences.speaker: Receptionist
sentences.text: I'll request a call after two today. I can't confirm a time until the team responds.
